payload.author: framework-coordinator
evidence: Independent original review: 5F2137 and 5F2143 branch directly to epilogue 5F21F8; 5F214F reaches polling without restoration when no saved sprite remains. Selection branches retain SetCursor return; skip-selection indices 0/1/3 retain hit index.

Authorized Win cursor family scope42 covers this coupled branch repair. Actual-source runtime controls exercise all 20 switch entries plus out-of-range, direct/custom early returns and return values. These are bounded branch controls, not original runtime equivalence or game acceptance.
payload.hypothesis: The cursor dispatcher must preserve its selection/index result and skip OS cursor polling when direct mouse mode or a freshly observed custom sprite is active. The old unconditional polling tail changed both side effects and return values.
